latest_release.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]  
> **YASB 2.x is moving to LTS**
>
> **YASB 3** is coming, and the 2.x line is now in maintenance mode. From now on 2.x gets only security fixes and critical bug fixes, with no new features. New features will go into YASB 3.
>
> YASB 3 is a full rewrite, and 2.x configs and themes don't carry over. To keep anyone from being moved to it by accident, starting with 2.0.9 a 2.x install will never update itself to 3.0 or later. It will still get 2.x fixes as usual.

In YASB 2.0.9, we fixed a crash in the **Claude usage** widget when the API doesn't return five-hour or seven-day limits.

Clicking the collapse or unpinned visibility buttons no longer steals keyboard focus from your current window.

Notifications won't get squeezed too narrow anymore.

Also, the updater will no longer try to jump to version 3.0 or later. Full changelog below.



### Bugfixes
- specify types for five and seven variables https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/2fe5f65517659eee9d07b4900f204e368efe9971
- set focus policy to NoFocus for collapse button and unpinned visibility button https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/521dfef89dc35dde43f167fa0d67fc3282c33290
- set minimum width for notification body widget https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/86c0adb8feff96b74c18545c816d48028c7ab3ce
- handle null five-hour and seven-day limits https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/7d5f0de9e01b2e84e9dd683caa816fbc4edbdf09

### Chores
- bump ruff from 0.17.1 to 0.17.6 https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/7741874d35d31a99ae1c344ad4e2d49c95cebe87
- bump certifi from 2026.10.19 to 2026.11.20 https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/6b3397ca5b7a985e3ea1b2744e4d344da9a96e6c
- prevent updates to version 3.0.0 or later https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/8dda651ceda54759316ec1e5fc33147a1054bdb8

### Other Changes
- Merge pull request #1258 from amnweb/dependabot/pip/ruff-0.17.6 https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/b3202da613d1a50e31ecb22d2224f327bf5643b1
- Merge pull request #1257 from amnweb/dependabot/pip/certifi-2026.11.20 https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/fe85984bc517f2d91aed6ff0b383e01f12817287
- Merge pull request #1138 from lechanm/fix/claude-usage-null-limits https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/commit/b4abc021d445a2451cd59110659a9fe5f6850125


## What's Changed
* fix(claude-usage): handle null five-hour and seven-day limits by @lechanm in https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/pull/1138
* chore(deps): bump certifi from 2026.10.19 to 2026.11.20 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/pull/1257
* chore(deps-dev): bump ruff from 0.17.1 to 0.17.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/pull/1258

## New Contributors
* @lechanm made their first contribution in https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/pull/1138

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/compare/v2.0.8...v2.0.9

detail.readme:
YASB Reborn

YASB (Yet Another Status Bar) is a highly configurable status bar for Windows, written in Python, with support for many widgets, easy theming, and deep customization.

Installation · Documentation · Themes · Discussions · Discord



## 📋 Installation For detailed installation instructions and system requirements, visit the [installation docs](https://github.com/amnweb/yasb/wiki/Installation). But to get started quickly, choose one of the installation methods below:

Download .msi from GitHub
Go to the YASB GitHub releases, click Assets to reveal the downloads, and choose the installer that matches your architecture and install scope. For most devices, that's the x64 per-user installer.
WinGet
Download YASB from WinGet. Updating YASB via winget will respect the current YASB installation scope. To install YASB, run the following command from the command line / PowerShell: *User scope installer [default]* ```powershell winget install AmN.yasb ``` *Machine-wide scope installer* ```powershell winget install --scope machine AmN.yasb ```
Scoop
Download YASB from Scoop. Updating YASB via Scoop will respect the current YASB installation scope. To install YASB using Scoop, run the following command from the command line / PowerShell: *Install YASB using Scoop* ```powershell scoop bucket add extras scoop install extras/yasb ```
Chocolatey
Download YASB from Chocolatey. Updating YASB via Chocolatey will respect the current YASB installation scope. To install YASB using Chocolatey, run the following command from the command line / PowerShell: *Install YASB using Chocolatey* ```powershell choco install yasb ```
